suite: Safety Gate Fault Injection Suite (6 Scenarios)

scenario_2_depth_dropout.explanation: Absence of secondary 3D depth does not crash safety supervisor; system remains in NORMAL under valid 2D LiDAR.

scenario_4_process_crash.hardware_watchdog_requirement: CRITICAL: When the supervisory software node crashes, user-space can no longer actively publish zero velocities. Physical motor controller firmware (STM32 MCU) MUST implement a hardware watchdog timer (<=200ms) that zeros PWM if /cmd_vel becomes silent, and the vehicle MUST feature a hardwired physical emergency stop button (E-Stop).
